### conversation.echo Source: https://docs.tavus.io/sections/event-schemas/conversation-echo Broadcast an echo event to Tavus so the PAL speaks exactly the supplied text or audio. Use this for echo-mode PALs, custom ASR flows, or other applications that provide the PAL's text or audio directly. ```APIDOC ## conversation.echo ### Description Broadcast an echo event to Tavus so the PAL speaks exactly the supplied text or audio. Use this for echo-mode PALs, custom ASR flows, or other applications that provide the PAL's text or audio directly. ### Event Type `conversation.echo` ### Message Type `conversation` ### Parameters #### Properties - **modality** (string) - Required - The modality of the echo (e.g., `text`). - **text** (string) - Required - The text to be spoken by the PAL. - **done** (boolean) - Required - Indicates whether the echo is complete. ### Request Example ```json { "message_type": "conversation", "event_type": "conversation.echo", "conversation_id": "your-conversation-id", "properties": { "modality": "text", "text": "Hello from an external echo.", "done": true } } ``` ### Response No response schema is documented for this event. ``` -------------------------------- ### conversation.interrupt Source: https://docs.tavus.io/sections/event-schemas/conversation-interrupt Broadcast this event to Tavus to externally interrupt the PAL so it stops talking. This is an inbound event sent to the conversation layer. ```APIDOC ## [EVENT] conversation.interrupt ### Description Broadcast this event to Tavus to externally interrupt the PAL so it stops talking. This is an inbound event sent to the conversation layer. ### Event Type `conversation.interrupt` ### Message Type `conversation` ### Parameters #### Event Fields - **message_type** (string) - Required - Must be `conversation` for conversation-layer app messages. Example: `"conversation"` - **event_type** (string) - Required - Must be `conversation.interrupt`. Example: `"conversation.interrupt"` - **conversation_id** (string) - Optional - Omitted when empty. Example: `"your-conversation-id"` ### Request Example ```json { "message_type": "conversation", "event_type": "conversation.interrupt", "conversation_id": "your-conversation-id" } ``` ### Response No response schema is documented for this event. ``` -------------------------------- ### conversation.interrupt Source: https://docs.tavus.io/sections/conversational-video-interface/interactions-protocols/overview Stops the face from speaking. Use this to interrupt the PAL's current speech. ```APIDOC ## [SEND] conversation.interrupt ### Description Stops the face from speaking. Use this to interrupt the PAL's current speech. ### Method sendAppMessage ### Endpoint call.sendAppMessage(interaction, '*') ### Parameters #### Request Body - **message_type** (string) - Required - Must be 'conversation'. - **event_type** (string) - Required - Must be 'conversation.interrupt'. - **conversation_id** (string) - Required - The conversation ID. ### Request Example ```json { "message_type": "conversation", "event_type": "conversation.interrupt", "conversation_id": "YOUR_CONVERSATION_ID" } ``` ### Response No response body is documented. ``` -------------------------------- ### useSendAppMessage Source: https://docs.tavus.io/sections/conversational-video-interface/component-library/hooks A React hook that provides a function to send CVI app messages to other participants in the call. It supports echo, respond, interrupt, and context management messages, enabling real-time communication with Tavus faces and conversation management. ```APIDOC ## useSendAppMessage ### Description A React hook that provides a function to send CVI app messages to other participants in the call. It supports echo, respond, interrupt, and context management messages, enabling real-time communication with Tavus faces and conversation management. ### Installation ``` npx @tavus/cvi-ui@latest add cvi-events-hooks ``` ### Return Value - `(message: SendAppMessageProps) => void` - Function that sends the message when called ### Message Types This hook supports all CVI interaction types. For detailed information about each interaction type and their properties, see the Interaction Events overview. ### Usage Example ``` import { useSendAppMessage } from './hooks/cvi-events-hooks'; ``` ``` const MessageSender = () => { const sendMessage = useSendAppMessage(); // Send a text echo const sendTextEcho = () => { sendMessage({ message_type: "conversation", event_type: "conversation.echo", conversation_id: "conv-123", properties: { modality: "text", text: "Hello, world!", audio: "", sample_rate: 16000, inference_id: "inf-456", done: true } }); }; // Send a text response const sendResponse = () => { sendMessage({ message_type: "conversation", event_type: "conversation.respond", conversation_id: "conv-123", properties: { text: "This is my response to the conversation." } }); }; return (
); }; ``` ``` -------------------------------- ### Make face speak supplied content with conversation.echo Source: https://docs.tavus.io/sections/conversational-video-interface/interactions-protocols/overview Use Daily's sendAppMessage to have the PAL speak text directly. For audio echo, set modality to 'audio', pass base64 audio, include sample_rate, and keep done: false until the final audio chunk. ```javascript call.sendAppMessage( { message_type: 'conversation', event_type: 'conversation.echo', conversation_id: 'YOUR_CONVERSATION_ID', properties: { modality: 'text', text: 'Text for the PAL to speak directly.', done: true, }, }, '*' ); ```
